- Pepperoni pizza, about two small pieces: ~90 g, ~250 kcal
- Breaded chicken: ~60 g, ~110 kcal

- Cauliflower, two pieces: ~60 g, ~30 kcal
- Eggplant: ~20 g, ~20 kcal
- Pork/meat salad with arugula: ~80 g, ~180 kcal
